name: Hsin Tai Gas Co., Ltd.
summary: Hsin Tai Gas Co., Ltd. operates as a natural gas provider throughout Taiwan. The company's activities encompass building natural gas distribution networks, offering sales and installation services for gas meters, and manufacturing and selling various gas-powered appliances. Additionally, it engages in the leasing of office properties. The firm was founded in 1975 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
